extracted.name: Campbell’s Tater Tot Casserole
extracted.description: Campbell’s tater tot casserole is an oven-baked cast iron skillet meal made with ground beef and condensed soup for an easy weeknight meal kids love.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup (Regular or 98% Fat Free)
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Heat a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir ground beef and onion in the hot skillet until beef is browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease.
Stir condensed soup, ketchup, and Worcestershire into the skillet. Spoon beef mixture into a 12x8-inch shallow baking dish. Arrange tater tots around the edge of casserole.
Bake in the preheated oven until tater tots are cooked through, about 25 minutes.
